title: Gina D NDE 4123
content: I bled out (twice) after childbirth, flat-lined.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Childbirth Bleed out due to post natal complications Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) Bleed out due to post natal complications
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Strong emotional tone | Boundary
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness As above.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I was not conscious to the normal world except for seeing down onto the doctors working on me and being aware I was up in a corner of the room. I could clearly see and describe the doctors, including baldheads and beards. If you mean awareness of my apparent surroundings, it seemed as normal as any other observation.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Seemed outside time. Time was not an issue.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm A long, brilliant but peaceful, tunnel. Here's the weird part: the tunnel seemed to be made of loose, soft cotten, held back by something like chicken wire.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I left my body and exited outside it and then lost awareness of my body. PEACE.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes I'm less possessive of people, less jealous of anyone, more sure that 'things will turn out alright'.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I'm less possessive of people, less jealous of anyone, more sure that 'things will turn out alright'. After the NDE
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I seem to be clairvoyant to some extent now, especially through dreams.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: I was assured everyone behind me (left behind) would be alright if I went on ahead, but urged to go back.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real It still seems real. In fact, it was so pleasurable that several years later (about twenty), after surgery, while recovering from anesthesia; I came to a point where I could relax into death and chose to do that. I was not allowed to, though, since the medical personnel caught the machines' warning and stopped me.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real Though some details have dimmed with time, I am SURE of the reality of it.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes Several years later (about twenty), after surgery, while recovering from anesthesia, I came to a point where I could relax into death and chose to do that. I was not allowed to, though, since the medical personnel caught the machines' warning and stopped me. March of this year (2009) a very realistic, reassuring, glorious, amazing dream.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: The dream was the most soul changing event, but the NDE was like a sidewalk to that door.
